title: eec-05b-merchant-console output
description: Merchant-side admin console mounted into the same repo produced by 05-site-build. Reads from 02 (catalog) / 06 (events) / 09 (KPIs) and writes routes under /admin/* in 05's repo. Phase-2 hooks reserve seats for 10-email-crm and 11-fulfillment when those skills land.

host_repo_path.description: Relative path to 05's repo. MUST equal 05.output.repo_path — this skill mounts INTO that repo, it does not create its own.

admin_base_path.description: Base URL prefix for the console. Default /admin. All admin_routes[].path MUST start with this.

admin_routes.description: Each admin page. MUST be noindex. MUST be auth-gated unless auth_strategy.type == 'none' (dev only).

path.description: URL path. MUST start with admin_base_path, e.g. /admin/dashboard

component.description: Route file path relative to host_repo_path, e.g. app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx

purpose.description: What the merchant uses this page for, in one sentence

data_binding_ids.description: References into data_bindings[]. Empty array allowed for static pages (e.g. login).

auth_required.description: false ONLY for /admin/login or public-facing admin entry points

noindex.description: Hard-locked true. Admin pages must never be indexed.

phase2_owner.description: Set when the route is a Phase-2 placeholder owned by skill 10 or 11. Drives empty-state copy.

data_bindings.description: How each admin route reads from upstream skill outputs. Bindings are READ-ONLY by default; set writes_back=true ONLY when the merchant action mutates an upstream skill's output.json.

source_skill.description: Where the data comes from. Skills are read from ./eec/<skill>/output.json; *_api values mean live API at runtime.

source_path.description: JSON-pointer or shorthand into the source. e.g. '$.skus[*]', '$.events_spec[*]', '$.diagnostics[*]', or for APIs the resource path '/products?limit=50'

refresh_strategy.description: build_time = baked into bundle (e.g. 02 SKUs). runtime_fetch = SSR per request. isr = Next.js revalidate. on_demand = merchant clicks refresh.

writes_back.description: true if the admin UI mutates the source. When true, the source must be one of the *_api enums OR an explicitly whitelisted skill output.

stub_until.description: Why the binding currently returns mock data instead of real. 'never' means real today.

auth_strategy.description: How merchant logins are gated. 'none' is dev-only — production MUST use session or oauth.

password_env_var.description: Env var holding the seed admin password hash (basic / session_cookie). Required for those types.

session_secret_env_var.description: Env var for signing session cookies. Required for session_cookie.

scope.description: admin_only = single role. role_based = multi-role RBAC; emit roles[] in next iteration.

writeback_target_files.description: Files (relative to host_repo_path) this skill is allowed to create or modify. MUST all be under app/admin/* OR explicitly listed config files. Mirrors 05's rebuild_protocol.writeback_target_files pattern.

phase2_hooks.description: Reserved admin route placeholders for Phase 2 skills. Each hook MUST point at an admin_routes[] entry whose phase2_owner field is set.

empty_state_copy.description: What the merchant sees today (e.g. 'Email campaigns appear here once /eec-10-email-crm runs')

expected_data_shape.description: Brief description of what the route will render once the owner skill produces output.json

noindex_audit.description: Self-check that the console is not indexable.

meta_robots_present_on_all_routes.description: Every admin_routes[] page renders <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
